content: The test image shows a soybean leaf with small, irregularly shaped dark brown lesions scattered across the upper surface, some with yellowish halos. Top candidates: **Septoria_brown_spot**, **Bacterial_Blight**, **Frogeye_leaf_spot**. Let me view reference images.

The test image shows a soybean leaf (upper surface) with:
- Small to medium, circular/irregular dark brown lesions scattered across the leaf
- Some lesions with yellowish halos
- Leaf still largely green

**Comparison with references:**
- **Frogeye_leaf_spot**: Reference (upper-right panel) shows very similar circular/irregular dark lesions with reddish-brown borders on a green leaf held in hand — strong visual match. Frogeye description: "small, irregular to circular, gray with reddish-brown borders."
- **Septoria_brown_spot**: Reference shows more numerous tiny spots on heavily yellowed/dying leaves — more advanced disease state, less matching.
- **Bacterial_Blight**: Reference shows more angular, water-soaked lesions; lesions in the test image are more circular/well-defined with reddish-brown margins, not angular.

The circular to irregular spots with dark reddish-brown borders on an otherwise green leaf are classic frogeye leaf spot.
